original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚河流州船只事故最后两具遗体寻获，死亡人数升至七人
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚河流州阿库库-托鲁地方政府区库拉水道罗伯特基里附近发生船只事故，最后两名遇难者遗体于周六晚间被寻获。此前三天已找到五具遗体，目前累计寻获遗体七具。相关消息由库拉王国办公室媒体团队在周日发布的声明中披露。

location.site: 阿库库-托鲁地方政府区库拉水道罗伯特基里
location.raw_text: Robertkiri, along the Kula waterways in Akuku-Toru Local Government Area, Rivers State

key_facts.fact: 河流州船只事故最后两名遇难者遗体被寻获，死亡人数升至七人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Last two bodies recovered as Rivers boat death toll hits seven

key_facts.fact: 事故发生在阿库库-托鲁地方政府区库拉水道的罗伯特基里
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Bodies of the two remaining victims of Tuesday’s boat accident at Robertkiri, along the Kula waterways in Akuku-Toru Local Government Area, have been recovered.

key_facts.fact: 最后两具遗体据报于周六晚间寻获
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The bodies were reportedly recovered on Saturday evening, and their identities were revealed.

key_facts.fact: 此前三天已寻获五具遗体，累计寻获七具
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: This comes three days after five bodies from the incident were recovered, bringing the total number of corpses recovered so far to seven.

uncertainties: 遇难者身份细节未在报道中完整披露
目前仅单一来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
